papers.title_en: DOFFO_TR: a Decentralized Objective Function-Free Optimization method with Trust-Region
papers.authors: Stefania Bellavia, Greta Malaspina, Benedetta Morini
papers.evidence: 去中心化多智能体优化方法，可作为多机器人协调算法的基础
papers.tldr: 现有分布式优化方法常依赖步骤调参且需共享梯度与函数值，存在隐私和效率问题。本文提出去中心化无目标函数信赖域算法，利用信赖域自适应选步长，支持一阶/二阶模型，避免共享敏感信息。理论证明其迭代复杂度可匹配集中式信赖域方法，实验显示通信开销适中且性能均衡。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel objective function-free trust-region method designed to solve optimization problems over decentralized networks. Unlike traditional approaches that often rely on stepsize tuning, our framework employs a function-free trust-region procedure that enables adaptive selection of the step length. Our approach accommodates first- and second-order models and eliminates the need to share local function values and gradients among agents, thereby enhancing privacy and computational efficiency. On the theoretical side, we establish provable iteration complexity guarantees that, for some variants, match those established for classical centralized trust-region methods. Numerical evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves a favorable trade-off between performance and efficiency, requiring only moderate communication overhead compared to state-of-the-art methods in the literature.
